evidence_kind: Pinned primary compiled implementation plus task-owned Java and XML declarations

facts.fact: An empty value buffer returns Java null; empty quoted text is not an omission instruction.
Nonnull scalar input is stored in the row data map; SQL staging and header inclusion still govern the emitted XML.
CSV attribute/header mappings determine included XML attributes independently of each scalar cell's null value.
The transform marks its dynamic VOs with XML_EXPLICIT_NULL=true before XML writing.
An included null value under explicit-null mode renders an element with null=true.
An element marked null=true reads as Java null.
Absent XML scalars are skipped; present changed values, including explicit null, reach the attribute setter list. Non-updateable VO attributes are skipped.

Alternate-key matches reuse existing primary keys; supported single globally-unique primary-key definitions generate IDs on a miss and propagate matching association keys to nested children. No client ID is needed or admitted.

Primary-key lookup supplies the existing row or null; a null row invokes createAndInitRow/createRow before XML attribute application. This generic create path does not establish every entity's defaults.

qualified_use: Miscellaneous no-determinant parent and ordinary child only, including LIMIT, PERCENT and BOTH rate types; native target qualification remains pending.
Own service resolves parent/child AltKey, then reads the nested Misc graph at depth -1 with both declared boolean arguments true.
Explicit managed DRAFT and N role/location/gender values. Monetary modes serialize SINGLE explicitly; PERCENT deliberately clears the nullable EO SINGLE default through explicit null.
Every create business rate-type/enforcement/control choice is explicit; no EO business default, rate amount, reset date or customer StartDate is inferred.
Own ordinary doCreateSingleRate supplies no TypeOfRateCode. Service migration currency getter suppresses parent inheritance; new ordinary type/currency and determinant coordinates stay raw null.

Null-first service getters return null for blank RoleName, GeoLocName and Raw geography fields without evaluating localized lookups; RoleCode/GradeCode derive no value with blank parent role/null RoleId.
Both import VOs mark the five audit attributes non-updateable; numeric primary/association IDs and audit values remain server owned.
boundaries: Source-qualified local preparation only. No target build parity, native create acceptance or persisted-state result is demonstrated.
Full business identity, no-Start uniqueness, inclusive schedules, exact parent association and operation-bound target lookups/currency remain mandatory.
Existing update fields keep exact uncertainty/native approval controls; no determinant, delete, key/status/currency update, retry or other-category admission.
No 100-percent maximum is invented; finite nonnegative local percentage policy is not a claim of broad server acceptance.
